summary.name: MiniMax
summary.one_liner: MiniMax is an AI company founded in early 2022 that develops multimodal foundation models and AI-native products spanning text, audio, image, video, and music.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes MiniMax as a general AI technology company founded in early 2022 with the goal of achieving AGI. It says the company has built a series of proprietary multimodal foundation models with code and agent capabilities and ultra-long context processing, handling text, audio, image, video, and music. It lists AI-native products including MiniMax Code, MiniMax Design, MiniMax Audio, and Talkie, plus an open platform for enterprises and developers. Latest research items named on the page include MiniMax M3.1 Flash, MiniMax Music 3.0 (described as open-weights), and MiniMax H3 (described as an open model).
notable: Proprietary multimodal foundation models covering text, audio, image, video, and music
